data.title: Drunk Myanmar driver kills 2 injures 2 in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A drunk Myanmar driver hit several motorcycles, killed two people and injured two others on the road to a waterfall in Thalang district, police said on Sunday.

data.title: German police hunt Islamist suspect in deadly gay parade attack
data.description: BERLIN - German police were searchin for a suspect believed linked to Islamist circles after a car ploughed into a crowd near Berlin's Gay Pride celebrations, killing one person and injuring 16 others.

data.title: Over 100 tied to local exam fraud
data.description: A government committee estimates more than 100 people from the public and private sectors may be involved in the local government exam fraud process.

data.title: Abhisit says face iLaw investigation publicly
data.description: Politicians identified by iLaw in its Senate election collusion investigation should respond publicly first rather than resorting immediately to legal action, says Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva.

data.title: Frenchman shot by police dies
data.description: A French man succumbed to his wounds after being shot by police during a knife rampage that injured an officer in Suan Luang district.

data.title: Fury destroys Wach, puts Pattaya in global spotlight
data.description: PATTAYA: Tyson Fury brought heavyweight boxing to an unlikely stage on Friday night as a packed Max Muay Thai Stadium welcomed one of the sport's biggest names for a rare appearance in Thailand. The former world heavyweight champion delivered a dominant performance, forcing veteran Mariusz Wach's corner to retire the Pole after seven one-sided rounds to claim the WBC Humanitarian Belt.

data.title: Thai doubles duo crash out in semis
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran bowed out in the semi-finals of the US$2 million BWF China Open on Saturday.

data.title: Neighbours swap citizens
data.description: SA KAEO: Authorities on Friday repatriated 36 Thai nationals from Cambodia and returned 67 Cambodian nationals through the Klong Luek border checkpoint.

data.title: Japan lauds closer defence relations
data.description: Japan and Thailand have strengthened defence ties as security challenges intensify across the Indo-Pacific, with Tokyo describing Bangkok as an indispensable partner in maintaining regional peace.

data.title: B2.1bn in land seized in nominee bust
data.description: The Interior Ministry has seized 126 rai of land worth more than 2.1 billion baht in Krabi after uncovering an alleged foreign nominee scheme involving a British national.

data.title: Petrol station denied extra payout over Cambodian rocket hit
data.description: The Si Sa Ket petrol station hit by a Cambodian rocket last year will not receive further compensation as its losses were fully covered by insurance and its parent company, the government says.

data.title: 1,500 kids linked to fake birth registration network
data.description: Nearly 1,500 children are suspected of receiving fake birth registrations through a network linked to eight private hospitals to obtain fraudulent Thai citizenship, said deputy national police chief Pol Gen Samran Nualma.

data.title: Axing Land Bridge 'the right move'
data.description: Opposition parties have welcomed the government's decision to abandon the Land Bridge megaproject in favour of a scaled-down "Missing Link" transport strategy, saying the new approach is more economically viable and better aligned with existing infrastructure.

data.title: City to deploy eco inspectors
data.description: Bangkok will establish environmental inspectors to strengthen law enforcement, reduce pollution risks and improve public health across the city.

data.title: Govt planning to shrink state sector
data.description: The government plans to reduce the public workforce from three million to two million under civil service reforms.

data.title: Govt's poverty test under fire
data.description: For 77-year-old Wimol Suanngam, the state welfare card is more than a monthly benefit. It represents a small measure of security in a life marked by hardship, disability and isolation.

data.title: Crisis-hit Flavio Bolsonaro launches presidential candidacy in Brazil
data.description: SAO PAULO - Battered by a string of political crises, Flavio Bolsonaro on Saturday prepared to formally launch his candidacy for Brazil's October presidential election, seeking to follow in the footsteps of his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

data.title: Thousands shelter from devastating fires in Bordeaux
data.description: BORDEAUX, France - Amid rows of camp beds and stacks of food supplies at a makeshift shelter in Bordeaux, thousands of tourists and locals try to regain their composure after fleeing wildfires sweeping through southwest France.

data.title: Thai hairdressers: lives behind the scissors
data.description: “Neighbourhood barbershops and salons are becoming places only for people who are too lazy to wash their own hair or who have certain physical limitations. For example, they may have just undergone eye surgery,” 53-year-old hairdresser Nong says with a laugh.

data.title: Krabi Leads Thailand's Staycation Boom as Short Getaways Surge
data.description: Traveloka data reveals Thai holidaymakers are trading long annual trips for frequent weekend breaks, with coastal retreats in Krabi seeing bookings double

data.title: Thailand risks falling behind as global longevity race gathers pace
data.description: Thailand has medical tourism and genomic strengths but lacks a unified national strategy as other countries invest in healthier ageing

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff has Prajanchai ‘in my sights’ as mind games begin after historic Sam-A KO
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan has warned Prajanchai PongSuphan PK that he is now firmly “in my sights” after finally forcing their long-simmering ONE Championship rivalry towards a title unification fight.

data.title: Thailand celebrates ninth World Heritage site
data.description: Thailand celebrated a major cultural milestone on Saturday as the Unesco World Heritage Committee approved the inscription of Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan in Nakhon Si Thammarat as a World Cultural Heritage site.

data.title: Indian minister steps down over exam scandal
data.description: NEW ⁠DELHI - ​Indian Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on Saturday, handing a major victory to youth protesters nationwide who had demanded that he quit to take responsibility for examination ​paper leaks.

data.title: Southern China braces for typhoon Noul
data.description: Strong ⁠winds and torrential rain ​lashed southern China on Saturday, brought by ​a strengthening typhoon Noul, ‌weather authorities said, urging people to avoid unnecessary travel as transport links could be disrupted.

data.title: UNESCO Names Nakhon Si Thammarat’s Wat Phra Mahathat a World Heritage Site
data.description: After 14 years on the tentative list, Wat Phra Mahathat becomes Southern Thailand's first UNESCO World Heritage site following a unanimous vote in Busan

data.title: Khlong Luang police chief transferred over alleged bribery
data.description: The chief of the Khlong Luang police station in Pathum Thani has been transferred to an inactive post pending an investigation after a recording purported to be of him soliciting bribes from the operator of a bar was circulated online.

data.title: Spain and France in grip of worst fires on record
data.description: Spain and France evacuated more than 160,000 people as out-of-control forest fires raged on Saturday near Madrid and Bordeaux, with the French army drafted in to help combat the worst wildfire the country has ever seen.
